description.narrative: Contract related to: MOLDOVA CYBERSECURITY RAPID ASSISTANCE - This 18-month measure aims to strengthen the Republic of Moldova¿s resilience to the crisis situation. It will support national efforts to increase the country¿s cyber- and information security while also providing inclusive assistance to the government and population in managing the refugee influx resulting from the war in Ukraine. In a first component, the measure will assist the establishment of a robust cyber threats monitoring and reaction mechanism (Cyber Security Operation Centre and/or national Computer Emergency Response Team ) under the responsibility of the Deputy Prime Minister for Digitalisation, to help identify possible cyberattacks and enable relevant authorities to launch and coordinate responsive action when necessary. In a second component, the action will support increased cooperation between government authorities, civil society, and the independent media, to increase media-literacy and to respond to disinformation. A third component will provide assistance to government authorities to ensure the inclusive hosting of recent arrivals from Ukraine, with a specific focus on strengthening the resilience of host-communities to mitigate deterioration in access to basic services linked to the refugee influx. This component will be implemented in close coordination with planned humanitarian and development cooperation assistance.
